It’s the Liveness, Stupid

The ChatGPT moment was ultimately a smooth extrapolation of existing trends. It was exciting but felt like a normal tech breakthrough. An extrapolation of what we’d seen years earlier. My first view was when a reader trained a simple Markov chain bot on my tweets in 2017. Another threw GPT2 at it in 2020. So ChatGPT wasn’t surprising so much as a couple of years early.
